intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aerofoil in helicopter flight?
Define the term 'boundary layer' in your own words.
List two factors that affect the flow over a body.

development.content:
Definition and shape of aerofoil
Leading edge and trailing edge
Chord line and camber line
Mean aerodynamic chord
Leading edge radius

topics: Effect of camber on lift curve
development.content:
Types of aerofoil sections
Symmetric vs asymmetric aerofoils
Thick vs thin aerofoils
Cambered aerofoil characteristics
Effect of camber on lift curve

Key geometric terms definitions
Angle of zero lift
Maximum camber location
Thickness distribution
Leading edge suction peak

summary_questions: Explain how the camber line influences the lift coefficient of an aerofoil.
Differentiate between a symmetric and an asymmetric aerofoil based on geometry.
Describe the significance of the mean aerodynamic chord in helicopter rotor analysis.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of aerofoil geometry introduced in this lesson apply to the rotor blade design discussed in LP 02.
